question: Founder wants to ship a half-baked v1 in 4 weeks vs polish for 4 months. Which call do I make?
baseline_answer:
## Answer

The brain doesn't make the call for you. Its only relevant evidence points toward the 4-week ship, and all of it comes from garry's resolved calls in the tactics domain.

- **Shipping v1 fast:** garry's claim that "Founders who ship v1 in <30 days hit PMF faster" resolved as correct (conviction weight 0.8, recorded 2024-02-10) [cat14/cat14-pos-2-tactics/take-1]. A 4-week v1 falls inside that 30-day window.
- **The cost of polishing:** garry's claim that "Polish-mode founders miss windows" resolved as correct (weight 0.75, recorded 2024-05-19) [cat14/cat14-pos-2-tactics/take-2]. This bears on the 4-month polish path.
- **Why speed matters:** garry's claim that "Velocity is the leading indicator of breakout" resolved as correct (weight 0.85, recorded 2024-11-04) [cat14/cat14-pos-2-tactics/take-3]. This is the strongest of the three.

Taken together, the track record favors the 4-week ship over the 4-month polish. All three are general tactical heuristics, not assessments of this founder or product. The brain also holds no active takes, so there is no evidence on the other side.

## Conflicts

None. No take in the brain contradicts these three, and all three come from the same holder.
